B01.reason: Runtime explicitly marks generative AI unavailable until a safe provider is configured.

B02.reason: No audio-aware generative section replacement operation exists in the current runtime.

B03.reason: Lyrics can be edited as text, but there is no local audio lyric replacement operation.

B04.reason: The authenticated Applio/RVC chain is live and now supports a fail-closed B04 mode that locks the frozen Demucs guide asset and SHA, exact 64-72 second phrase, identity profile recipe, exact active voice-model PTH/index hashes, and an owned active voice_identity_reference whose SHA must equal the frozen provider-input vocal. The worker clips before conversion, verifies guide/model hashes, rejects PCM-identical neural output, bounds localized output duration, uploads a private retained FLAC, and the callback re-verifies region and identity lock before registering evidence. Three historical full-guide v7.1 renders (natural/identity/smooth) prove the engine/model lineage but are explicitly non-scoring because they predate the identity-reference lock and are not localized. Official B04 remains unexecuted because the frozen provider-input vocal SHA 85b6341b... is not yet ingested and active as the model identity reference; no score or hard-gate pass is awarded until that asset is privately ingested, the exact localized render is retained, and timbre/formant/performance/speaker metrics plus blind review are complete.

B05.reason: PT-BR lyric analysis exists, but no sung-vocal generation exists locally.

B06.reason: The dedicated note-aware correction path is implemented and has completed one retained engineering smoke on a verified non-benchmark Pablo Voice variant. That smoke reduced median absolute pitch error from 17.5 to 12.5 cents while preserving median relative vibrato at 0.998, but corrected only 0.56% of the source under the locked conservative guards. Because the smoke source is not the frozen benchmark vocal, it is explicitly non-scoring and does not promote B06. Official B06 still requires the frozen benchmark vocal to be ingested privately, rendered, retained, hashed, and acoustically reviewed.

B07.reason: Canonical authenticated high/low harmony provider targets the deployed Rubber Band + librosa v7.5.2 route with formant preservation. The high adaptive-partial path has one verified historical execution; the low path is implemented but deliberately marked unexecuted. B07 remains unscored and non-promotable until both frozen high and low layers are rendered against benchmark inputs and retained.

B08.reason: The canonical Studio now has a guarded macro-arrangement density planner that applies persisted time-local gain automation only to explicitly selected accompaniment tracks. The lead vocal, lyrics, track order, asset identities, duration, trims, offsets, gain, pan, mute/solo, effects and non-target automation are protected. The frozen v1 plan is attenuation-only and uses runtime region automation already shared by playback and offline rendering. This is macro-arrangement rather than instrument regeneration, and B08 remains unscored until a frozen-reference render is retained and reviewed for arrangement adherence, melody preservation, vocal identity and continuity.

B09.reason: A real authenticated standalone Demucs/Kaggle stems route is implemented, but no completed standalone stems render_job exists yet. Per-track export and stems produced only inside full pipelines do not count as the required B09 source-separation execution.

B10.reason: A deterministic PT-BR conversational edit engine maps the frozen non-DAW command to exact supported local operations, scopes preservation to the explicit clause, and fails closed on unsupported requests. Retained execution evidence is still required before scoring.

B11.reason: A guarded three-step conversational edit sequence preserves project identity, lyrics, track order, all non-selected tracks, selected source identity, duration/sample layout, offset/trim/gain/mute/solo while allowing only requested supported effect/pan changes. Acoustic continuity evidence is still required before scoring the hard gate.

B12.reason: Master WAV render exists; aligned stereo per-track rendering preserves project duration, avoids per-stem normalization, rejects >0 dBFS stems instead of silently clipping, and fixes master channel selection. Benchmark output still must be executed and retained before scoring.

promotion_rule: Implementation readiness is not a benchmark pass. A test becomes scorable only after its full required operation produces retained output evidence against the frozen inputs.
